# action.docker_container_restart

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: action. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Restarts a container, like `docker container restart`: a stop (signal, grace period, SIGKILL) followed by a start. A stopped container is just started. The result object holds the container's `state` after the call.

Actions need Terraform >= 1.14. They keep no state: they run when a
resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` fires, or on demand with
`terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_container_restart.<name>`. Arguments go inside
the action's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
action "docker_container_restart" "<name>" {
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}

# Run it: lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [after_create] actions = [action.docker_container_restart.<name>] } }
# on a resource, or: terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_container_restart.<name>
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `container_id` | `string` | required |  |  | The container the action targets, by ID or name, e.g. `docker_container.app.id`. |
| `result_path` | `string` | optional |  |  | Local file the action writes its result object to after a successful run. The file holds one JSON object keyed by the action's output names (`result`, the identity values, the raw outputs with their `*_sha256` hashes, and the version values), with keys sorted at every level, two-space indentation and a trailing newline; it is written atomically (temporary file, then rename) and parent directories are created. Read it in a later run with `jsondecode(file(...))` or the `local_file` data source. Sensitive values are written in full, since this is your own file, but show as `(sensitive)` in the progress message. Nothing is written when the action fails. |
| `signal` | `string` | optional |  |  | Signal sent to stop the container (Engine `signal`). Default: the container's `StopSignal`, else `SIGTERM`. |
| `timeout` | `number` | optional |  |  | Seconds to wait for the container to exit before SIGKILL (Engine `t`). `-1` waits forever, `0` kills at once. Default: the container's `StopTimeout`, else 10. |

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_container" "app" {
  name  = "app"
  image = "nginx:1.27"

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_container_restart.app]
    }
  }
}

# Restart a container after its configuration changed. On demand:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_container_restart.app
action "docker_container_restart" "app" {
  config {
    container_id = docker_container.app.id
    timeout      = 10
    result_path  = "${path.module}/out/restart.json"
  }
}
```
